articles.summary: Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN) (“Janus Living”), a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT), announced that on September 11, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a monthly common stock cash dividend of $0.0475 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026, payable on the payment dates set forth in the table below to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the corresponding record date in the table below. The monthly dividend reflects an annualized dividend amount of $0.57 per share of common stock.
